name: Kudou Kouji
source:
Kouji's a shy schoolmate from [url=https://vndb.org/c17365]Takuya[/url]'s high school. While most other guys have only acknowledged Takuya's [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]new attributes[/url], Kouji on the other hand has fallen fully head over heels in love with "her". That fervent feeling of love will make Kouji gather enough courage so that he can send a love letter to Takuya, in hopes of seducing the object of his most passionate desires. Will his confession be answered with the same kind of feelings by Takuya?

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582010-x-change/faqs/22272]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
